title: F25 · Ear-length ragged side part / Slender curved hook / Sparse broken arches

request.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. ONE full-body 2D Guarin. Change the specified HAIR, NOSE and EYEBROWS only. The two EYES are FIXED original F25 marks, never an exploration variable.
Input roles: IMAGE 1 is the exact named original character base, authority for its jaw, cheeks, mouth, body, pose, camera, costume, palette and granular drawing medium. If supplied, full F25 is an EYES-ONLY source. The LAST image is an exact unscaled ORIGINAL F25 eye crop containing NO eyebrows. It shows the two fixed black eye marks. Do NOT use any F25 eyebrow treatment as a constant: eyebrows change in this request.
EYES ARE LOCKED: reproduce those exact two solid dark eye marks, their unequal perspective widths, shape, size and center spacing. At the 1312-pixel canvas width, the near mark is 20×15 pixels, far mark 15×14 pixels and horizontal center spacing 88.5 pixels. They stay dark squares with the same weary gaze, without whites, irises, highlights, rings, round dots, closed slits, lashes or changed size. Keep the actual eye marks at the same height and spacing. Eyebrow variations must NOT alter, reshape, obscure or squint the eyes. Eye shapes are fixed, EYEBROWS ARE VARIABLE. Do not lock the whole eye-and-brow region.
Preserve the base's own facial silhouette, jaw and cheek shape, dirty stubble, weary closed mouth and adult identity. Preserve its oversized head, tiny squat body, elevated three-quarter view, framing, pose and charcoal background. Same ragged wine-red scarf/cape, dull mail, brown gloves, belt, wrapped legs/boots, straight sword and battered wood-and-iron kite shield. No rotation or equipment redesign. Hair stays dirty dark brown; the existing pale temple mark may stay small or be covered naturally.
Match the original flat 2D game medium: coarse broken muddy pigment, ragged dark edges, taupe/brown/dull bone/dead wine red. Facial marks and hair must share the body grain and restrained light. Dark, poor, worn, exhausted and hopeless with cute compact proportions. No 3D, toy volume, airbrushing, clean comic/vector features, glossy hair, bright color or grin. Noses vary as specified and must be curved/rounded rather than square columns. One complete full-body drawing, no text, panels or insets.

Exact character base: F25.
Variant F65, hairstyle 2 and nose 2.
HAIRSTYLE: Uneven ear-length dark brown shag with a rough side part, two or three long broken locks crossing the upper forehead, messy coarse outward ends beside the ears and nape. Clearly longer than a crop. No fashionable fade, polished salon styling or smooth glossy hair.
NOSE: A narrow slender bridge with a shallow curved hump, tapering to a small rounded downward hook. Two irregular broken pigment strokes and a tiny dim underside. Long enough to contrast clearly with the button, but restrained. No square end, cuboid geometry or glossy anatomical gradients.
EYEBROWS: Sparse shallow curved eyebrows made of three separated coarse pigment dabs each, unequal and frayed, with clear gaps. A weary ragged arch instead of a straight heavy bar. Keep the underlying eye marks completely unchanged.
Final invariant: only hair, nose and eyebrow design vary. The two original F25 eye marks remain identical in design, size, spacing and gaze.
